ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity black pixels to 30% high-intensity white pixels, displaying a binary-dominant distribution with minimal mid-tone gradients.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous regions are localized at the distal tips of both lobes. These white regions transition into the central black region through vertical, high-frequency pixel intrusions resembling brush strokes. The central peduncle and lower lobe areas are solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-measured interior angle of approximately 52 degrees, extending deep into the fluke center relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with distinct jagged peaks; higher frequency and amplitude of notches are visible on the medial portion of the right lobe trailing edge compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a strong concave curvature toward the distal tips, while the lateral leading edges follow a smooth convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparsely distributed white circular pixel clusters (scars) are visible against the black ventral surface in the lower central region. Dense clusters of active calcified structures are concentrated on the lateral and distal margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical black-on-white linear disruptions at the pigment boundary on both lobes. Fine-scale diagonal scratches are visible within the white high-intensity patch on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation and colonization by barnacles on the extreme distal tips of both lobes, creating an irregular, lumpy protrusion from the natural fluke edge. Several small circular depigmented marks present on the central black surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of dark brown/tan organic matter (likely whale lice or gooseneck barnacles) clustered specifically on the outer trailing edges of both lobe tips.
